title: Dylan Tweney — 'A better word is corruption', and Ries's book tells you how to fight it
summary: Dylan Tweney — longtime technology journalist (former Wired) and editor of the Tweney Media newsletter — argues that Cory Doctorow's 'enshittification' framing leaves readers in despair and rage, while Ries's 'corruption' framing in Incorruptible gives them the tools to fight back. Frames the book as offering both diagnosis and treatment.
blockquote: A better word is corruption - as Eric Ries persuasively and eloquently describes in his book, Incorruptible. And the thing about Ries's book is that it tells you what you need to know to fight against it, which Cory's term doesn't - it just leaves you in despair and rage.
attribution_title: Technology journalist (former Wired); Tweney Media newsletter
